description: This Java class 'Placeholders' provides utility methods for detecting placeholders in strings, supporting both new '{{ prefix:key }}' format and legacy '${prefix.key}' format, using regex patterns.

classes.name: Placeholders
classes.description: Utility class for detecting placeholders in strings, supporting multiple placeholder formats.

methods.name: pattern
methods.description: Returns the regex pattern that matches any placeholder format.

methods.name: groupNames
methods.description: Returns a list of group names used in placeholder regex patterns.

methods.name: containsAnyPlaceholder
methods.description: Checks if the input string contains any placeholder, either new or legacy format.
